Title: Add a new expense transaction manually
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app with no existing transactions
Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen to open the Add Transaction sheet. 2. Select 'Expense' as the transaction type. 3. Enter 'Groceries' as the title. 4. Enter '500' as the amount. 5. Select 'Shopping' as the category. 6. Select 'Cash' as the source. 7. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Groceries, Amount: 500, Category: Shopping, Source: Cash
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and appears in the transaction list on the home screen. The balance updates to reflect a new expense of 500 in the selected currency. The transaction shows 'Groceries', '500', 'Shopping', and 'Cash' as the source.

Title: Add a new income transaction manually
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app with no existing transactions
Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen to open the Add Transaction sheet. 2. Select 'Income' as the transaction type. 3. Enter 'Salary' as the title. 4. Enter '30000' as the amount. 5. Select 'Salary' as the category. 6. Select 'Bank' as the source. 7. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Salary, Amount: 30000, Category: Salary, Source: Bank
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and appears in the transaction list on the home screen. The balance updates to reflect a new income of 30000 in the selected currency. The transaction shows 'Salary', '30000', 'Salary', and 'Bank' as the source.

Title: Edit an existing transaction
Preconditions: User has at least one transaction recorded (e.g., an expense of 500 for Groceries)
Steps:
1. Tap on the existing transaction in the list to open the edit sheet. 2. Change the amount from '500' to '600'. 3. Change the category from 'Shopping' to 'Food'. 4. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Updated Amount: 600, Updated Category: Food
Expected Result: The transaction is updated in the list. The balance reflects the updated amount of 600. The transaction details now show '600' and 'Food' as the category.

Title: Change the app currency from default to another currency
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app
Steps:
1. Tap the settings icon in the bottom navigation bar. 2. Tap on 'Currency' under the App Settings section. 3. Select 'USD - US Dollar' from the list. 4. Return to the home screen.

Test Data: Currency: USD - US Dollar
Expected Result: The app currency updates to USD. All transaction amounts and balance totals on the home screen are displayed in USD with the '$' symbol.

Title: Add a transaction with a future date
Preconditions: User is on the home screen of the app
Steps:
1. Tap the '+' button at the bottom of the screen to open the Add Transaction sheet. 2. Select 'Expense' as the transaction type. 3. Enter 'Rent' as the title. 4. Enter '10000' as the amount. 5. Select 'Rent' as the category. 6. Select 'Bank' as the source. 7. Tap the date field and select a date 5 days in the future. 8. Tap the 'Save' button.

Test Data: Title: Rent, Amount: 10000, Category: Rent, Source: Bank, Date: Future date (5 days ahead)
Expected Result: The transaction is saved and appears in the transaction list sorted by date. The future-dated transaction appears at the top of the list if no other future transactions exist.
